data.title: 黑馆晴奈 · 街角美馔爆发的决然风度
data.description: 喧嚣街区拐角处，伴随着轰然巨响与冲天黑烟，一家粗制滥造的黑心快餐店化作华丽火海。晴奈手提重型狙击步枪，迈着优雅从容的步伐从浓烟与烈焰中信步走出，皮草斗篷在热浪中翻飞。她神色自若地回眸望向赶来的老师，露出毫无悔意的潇洒绝美微笑。
data.location: city street corner before explosive fire and smoke
data.action: striding forward with sniper rifle, dramatic explosion backdrop, confident unapologetic smile
data.lighting: vivid fiery orange explosion glow and dramatic backlighting
data.mood: explosive chaos, unstoppable swagger, and theatrical defiance
data.promptProse: Striding effortlessly away from a blazing cinematic kitchen explosion, Kurodate Haruna carries her sniper rifle with poised aristocratic composure and a fearless smile.
data.animaCaption: Haruna striding calmly with her sniper rifle before a dramatic kitchen explosion.
